named_question: Can the already supported selected SName set, clear and explicit ASCII-normalization branches be previewed with identical ordered guards and actual planned storage, without mutation or save?

existing_source_basis.relationship: Existing selected SName writer, uppercase ASCII admission, explicit empty-string clear and omission-preserving no-op define the unchanged transaction. Name is a different field.
Existing explicit opt-in converts ASCII lowercase before strict validation, reports normalized_from even on storage no-op and admits no other normalization.
Reuse immutable-plan, early-return and output conventions only. No Name-specific nonempty restriction or other metadata operation's numeric, boolean or graph guard is imported.

canonical_sources.relationship: Column7 commits normalized text to the actual selected record at +0x30 without the column0 nonempty guard.
SName binds to +0x30 separately from Name, IDs, flags and output data.
SName normalization has additional non-ASCII and punctuation operations; the existing admitted subset deliberately avoids them.
Existing transliteration dependency is not newly implemented or approximated.
Existing conversion loop supplies the already supported explicit ASCII uppercase opt-in.
ASCII a..z maps to A..Z; the opt-in still runs the unchanged strict validation afterward.
Common normalization remains outside the conservative no-change ASCII subset. No trimming or replacement is added.
Selected member string copy has no sibling deduplication or unrelated-field update.
Reader omission becomes empty text; native optional-string serialization can omit empty SName. The CLI's unchanged writer instead stores explicit empty only when clearing a nonempty value.

source_verification: All nine relevant canonical function hashes and all three reused public artifact hashes were verified against the existing frozen local corpus and current checkout. Static-byte evidence is inherited from the existing SName artifacts, not newly extracted or promoted. No vendor function text is included.

CLI_policy.command: lox config lighting set-mood-display-name FILE BLOCK --mood SID_OR_NAME (--name NAME [--normalize-ascii] | --clear) --dry-run [--room ROOM] [--save-as PATH]
CLI_policy.architecture: One private immutable LightingMoodDisplayNamePlan holds the existing selected path and unchanged LightingMoodDisplayNameEdit. Both existing writer entrypoints and public ConfigEditor::preview_lighting_mood_display_name(&self, selector, mood_ref, name, normalize_ascii) share it. The preview adds before_effective and after_stored without changing the writer report. No cloned XML, writer-then-discard, diff simulation or generic framework.
CLI_policy.ordered_admission: CLI flag and room-selector guards remain unchanged. The planner applies ASCII uppercasing only when explicitly requested, then validates the existing uppercase ASCII letters/digits/internal ordinary spaces and alphanumeric edges, allowing empty only through the existing API/explicit CLI clear. Next use existing block resolution, require exactly LightController2, one direct LightscenesC and one direct mood matching exact stored SID spelling or case-sensitive Name. Numeric Name/SID collisions and multiple matching records remain ambiguous. No numeric parsing, positive SID, sibling numeric uniqueness, role, visibility, Num, boolean, graph, permission, deduplication or maximum-length policy is added.
CLI_policy.clear_and_noop: Nonempty stored SName clears to explicit empty, never removal. Omitted/already-empty clear is unchanged and preserves its raw storage. Supported identical names and equivalent explicit ASCII normalization remain no-ops; normalized_from still shows changed supplied text. Unsupported strings remain errors even if identical to stored text. Prior arbitrary strings may be replaced or cleared without being revalidated.
CLI_policy.report: JSON retains the unchanged edit fields: actual selected raw UUID/SID/CID, before (null when omitted), effective planned after, changed and normalized_from. Preview additionally reports before_effective (omission reads empty), after_stored (null for retained omission, empty for explicit empty), dry_run=true and optional trace_id. These are stored-text semantics, not inherited or physical display labels.
CLI_policy.formats: Dedicated table/CSV retain selected identity, raw/effective before/after, normalization input and changed, including clear/no-op. Table quotes present strings to distinguish explicit empty and literal sentinel text from omission. CSV quotes strings and includes presence fields. Quiet suppresses only the table summary; no-header only headers. Normal writer output/CSV column order are unchanged.
CLI_policy.read_only: Only this command is newly admitted to global --dry-run. Return before mutation/save for input/existing/new missing-directory save-as, no-op or failure. No source/destination/default/stamp/directory/cache/telemetry writes, destination-writability checks or serialization/write-success predictions.
CLI_policy.preservation: Existing writer signatures/report/save/stamp/no-op behavior remain unchanged. Actual changes still write only selected SName. Preserve Name, raw identity/flag/output lexemes, count/width/order, sequences, LSConfig, HCL, capabilities, siblings and opaque storage. Missing/empty/opaque identities and numerically equivalent siblings retain the existing selection admission.
CLI_policy.failure: Identical existing diagnostics, never empty success. All unrelated unsupported mutations remain fail-closed.

regressions.unit: Two lighting_metadata_display_name_preview tests compare immutable plans with both writers and selected-only XML including BOM/CRLF, omission/empty/numeric/raw prior text, no-op/clear/explicit normalization, uninterpreted IDs/flags, equivalent numeric siblings and ordered error parity.
regressions.CLI: Three lighting_metadata_cli_display_name_dry_run tests cover exact source/destination preservation, writer/report/persisted-edit parity, explicit ASCII policy, flag/name/selection errors, room/bracket selection, JSON/table/CSV, quiet/no-header and trace conventions.
regressions.side_effects: tests/dry_run.rs lighting_display_name_preview_has_no_filesystem_or_network_side_effects snapshots input/output/config/cache/token/home/directory bytes and metadata with telemetry enabled and a local mock backend, across set/clear/no-op/normalization/failure and all destination forms.
regressions.dispatch: src/dry_run.rs admits only SetMoodDisplayName in addition to prior supported paths; unrelated recount-moods and other unsupported mutations remain fail-closed. Prior CID/SID/Mix/Skip/Name previews and metadata edits remain regression-covered.

native_validation.limits: Read-only source-backed CLI preview of one already supported stored selected-field operation only. No new Unicode admission/transliteration/trimming/normalization policy, native case, GUI Cancel/dialog refresh, native accepted-dialog serialization/final-save/write-success prediction, live graph/role/visibility/permission claims, physical display behavior, SPS/runtime/family or whole-file parity. Historical artifacts and separate native owners' work are unchanged.
